{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv')

# Clean the revenue column: remove commas and convert to float
df['revenue_clean'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '', regex=False).astype(float)

# Filter for completed orders from loyal customers
df_filtered = df[(df['customer_segment'] == 'loyal') & (df['status'] == 'completed')]

# Compute mean revenue
mean_revenue = df_filtered['revenue_clean'].mean()

print("Number of loyal customers with completed orders:", len(df_filtered))
print("Mean revenue of completed orders from loyal customers:", mean_revenue)"}
